# Preface {.unnumbered}

This handbook explains common bioinformatics tasks for plant wet-lab researchers.
All examples use toy data; no real sequencing data is distributed with this book.

This handbook is mainly for the beginner of the bioinformatics. It is better to understand the basic concepts of the computer and molecular biology to read this book.
